note: The three routes to an embedded NUL that do not go through the reader. Emacs answers (1 1 3): a NUL is an ordinary character to `char-to-string`, `make-string` and `concat` alike. kg answers `wrong-type-argument` -- its `characterp` check rejects 0 before any string is built, so the refusal is kg's own natives and NOT fe's reader, which is why this is a separate case from string25-nul-read-and-length.
